Hello! I'm **Professor Alvarez**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Good to meet you.

Briefly, what I am and can do:

- **Web app** — from a phone or computer on the same network, open https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): the first visit lets you take the certificate, and then you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- **My own chat accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts, so you can write and call me there, and my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **My own accounts on websites and services** — I can sign up (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.
